result.reason: The revision provides a 90-day deliverable warranty, but does not expressly require professional and workmanlike services, a services warranty period, repair/replacement/refund remedies, legal compliance, or absence of malicious code. References to other unidentified sections cannot establish those requirements, and the clause removes the original correction/refund language without supplying the required remedies. It also unnecessarily changes the trigger from delivery to acceptance, adds acceptance criteria and broad claim-preservation language, and duplicates the section number.
